name: MetaMorpho vault (Morpho Blue allocator)
description: MetaMorpho: an ERC-4626 vault that supplies its asset to Morpho Blue lending markets in a curated supply queue and withdraws through a withdraw queue; fees are minted as shares. Held-out case: analysed without analyzer changes. Morpho Blue itself is outside the analysed scope (interface only).

instances.label: MetaMorpho
instances.description: ERC-4626 vault allocating to Morpho Blue markets.

assets.label: vault asset
assets.description: ERC4626 asset passed to the constructor.

notes: Only MetaMorpho.sol and its transitive imports are part of the snapshot (recreate with scripts/fetch_snapshot.py corpus/metamorpho).
MORPHO is an immutable set in the constructor; no deployment is configured, so it stays an external contract identified by the state variable.
